summary: Four distilled cap-design reports (CapDesignBasis, CapDesignEndBentOne, CapDesignEndBentTwo, CapDesignPier; 19 October 2026 cases, decision D-051) are appended to the journal as registered modules and linked from the PedBridge index. In FBMPEndBent, block 2 of the current end-bent design record (longitudinal reinforcement) now reads CapDesignEndBentOne and CapDesignBasis instead of repeating typed counts and areas; EBLongitudinalSummary has no typed copies. All other components are byte identical.
published_outputs: CapDesignBasis: phi_f, phi_v, phi_a, gamma_e, lambda, s_proj and the bar functions Ab(k), Db(k)

CapDesignEndBentOne and CapDesignEndBentTwo: Status (current distilled result: There are FAILURES, face bar spacing), 62 DC_* ratios each, and the reinforcement inputs n_N1, Bar_N1, n_P1, Bar_P, n_B1, Bar_B, n_skin, Bar_skin
CapDesignPier: Status (current distilled result: All Checks Pass), 62 DC_* ratios. Distilled numerical checks only, not design acceptance

FBMPEndBent: EBSteel_topCount, topAreaEach, bottomCount, bottomAreaEach, addedCount, addedAreaEach, skinEachSide, skinAreaEach are live references to CapDesignEndBentOne / CapDesignBasis.Ab(...) (units: counts dimensionless, areas in^2); EBSteel_AsTop, AsPile, AsSpan, AsSkinSide keep their formulas; EBSteel_fc, fy, Es unchanged and still literal
assumptions_and_conventions: Both end bents follow the End Bent 1 configuration (user direction in the 8 October record), so the repointed EBSteel_* read CapDesignEndBentOne; End Bent 2 has its own report that nothing else reads

L_cap = 251 in is kept as a literal in the End Bent 1 and End Bent 2 reports: BridgeGeometry_2Beam.EndBentCap_length is 17 ft 8 in (212 in, 8 October record, EndBent_endDetail = 4 in) while decisions D-026/D-027/D-036 give 235-in end caps and the cap cases use the 251-in cap plus cheek cage envelope (D-027: 235 in + two 8 in cheeks). Recorded as literal_incoherent_journal in cap_bpad/journal/coherence.json, not fixed here
PierCapDesign (C005) is read only for the pier covers and materials and stays unchanged under decision D-003; CapDesignPier duplicates its scope

Blocks 1 and 3 of the end-bent design record (8 October context, actual transverse schedule) are not refreshed; the transverse schedule remains the 8 October record and the new report holds the current station schedule
Added reports are bare fragments from cap_bpad/journal (LF line endings, 2-space indent) appended unchanged; the rest of the journal is CRLF
downstream_impact: EBSteel_AsTop, AsPile, AsSpan, AsSkinSide change from the 8 October record (1.76 / 1.58 / 2.2 / 1.4 in^2) to the current case (2.2 / 3.16 / 4.09 / 1.76 in^2); the counts and bars change from 4 #6, 2 #8, 2 #5 added, 7 #4 skin to 5 #6, 4 #8, 3 #5 added, 4 #6 skin
No other module reads EBSteel_* (searched the whole journal); check reports no detected downstream impact
FBMPEndBent and the cap reports now reference each other (EBSteel_fc/fy/Es into the cap reports; n_*/Bar_* into FBMPEndBent), with no variable-level cycle; native Blockpad has not evaluated this
The pier cap reads PierCapDesign covers and materials, so a change to C005 flows into CapDesignPier
external_analysis: FBMP models and results are unchanged and were not re-run. The end-bent steel in the FBMP analysis is not re-derived from the new longitudinal record; the 8 October analysis snapshot in FBMPEndBent stays as recorded. Currency of FBMP results against the 19 October reinforcement is not asserted.
checks_performed: cap_bpad/journal/verification.json (builder): End Bent 1 891 and End Bent 2 891 and Pier 859 comparisons against the cap tool, 535 Mathcad sheet values compared per cap, 14/14/15 journal references verified, fragment SHA-256 matched by build_components.py before copying
tests/test_cap_bpad.py: 18 tests OK (run with the .venv interpreter)

tasks/T012/verify_task.py (independent-checks.json): 12 of 12 checks pass - component order, candidate differs from the current journal only in the six registered components, report.json changed set, no new structural issues or stored errors, every Report.name reference in the four new reports and the edited section resolves, new reports read only declared owners, 45 coherence.json owner values equal the candidate owner definitions, EBSteel_* caches equal count x area from the cap literals, PedBridge diff is exactly the four links, FBMPEndBent diff confined to the intro paragraph and block 2, fragments equal verification.json hashes
bpad_workflow check T012 and assemble T012 passed (structural_delta passed, 0 cached errors, no inherited or candidate structural issues)

BridgeGeometry_2Beam.EndBentCap_length (212 in) remains incoherent with the 235-in end caps and the 251-in envelope the cap reports use; a geometry decision and task are needed to remove the L_cap literal
